correctness.rationale: For each nonzero request a, three distinct disjoint XOR-pair types and singleton copies give the exact equal-request capacity M_a=x_a+sum_{b<c,b XOR c=a}min(x_b,x_c). Summing all a gives 4n-(1/2)sum_{b<c}|x_b-x_c|; balanced integer multiplicities minimize discrepancy r(7-r), giving total capacity at n=11 of 38<42 and at n=12 of 43<49. Padding excludes all shorter lengths. The pinned full 66,621-byte recovery_witnesses.json was read and an independently written 2640-case mixed-request enumerator checked all masks, disjointness, max-two size, and exact XOR (924 for t=6,1716 for t=7; zero invalid). The 12/13-column generators contain a binary basis. This is an exhaustive finite certificate for exactly these two parameters, not an infinite-parameter extrapolation.
residual_risks: The certified optima are restricted to dimension three over GF(2), t=6 or 7 and recovery locality at most two. No classification of all optimizers is proved.

evidence: Full Resultary Oct13 theorem https://github.com/Resultary/2026/tree/main/2026/10/13/SCOPE-exact-binary-dimension-three-six-request-functional-batch-length--4abf711d3224 gives length eleven for t=6 with recovery sets of size up to THREE, not two.
The general functional-batch minimum has weaker locality restrictions; the double simplex at t=8 does not imply the punctured t=6 and 7 locality-two witnesses.
broader_coverage.reasoning: An unrestricted or locality-three solution cannot imply a max-two recovery solution; stronger request count for the unpunctured 14-column code does not force optimal lengths under puncturing.

value.rationale: The minimum storage length under a strict two-symbol recovery budget is a natural and operationally meaningful parameter, and six and seven are consecutive nontrivial batch-load cutoffs. Exact tight lower bounds plus all mixed-request recoveries resolve a finite problem that unrestricted or locality-three results do not settle. Generalization or paper-sized theory is not required for the precise finite optimal values.
residual_risks: Value is parameter-specific; does not imply optima for dimension >3, larger t or different alphabets.
